description: This file is a shell script used to test the behavior of 'git cherry'. It defines test cases, sets up git repositories, performs commits, cherry-picks, and verifies the output of 'git cherry' under various conditions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the timestamp used in commits for reproducibility.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified changes.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output, failing if they differ.
